title: Mounted Cyndaquil crosses a field-stream boundary on held input

verification.actor: One prepared MOUNTED Cyndaquil with its normal cardinal Walk profile, current live handle, and attached presentation
verification.trigger: Hold normal RIGHT input for 20 tiles on the clear Route29 lane, release through the normal bounded skid, then tap LEFT and drain one recovery tile
verification.observable: At least 20 east Walks cross a full 16-tile field-stream boundary; at most one queued east Walk and one or two policy skid tiles drain after release, each path advance precedes commit, and one west recovery returns control to the same actor

setupMutations.change: Teleport to the reviewed Route29 origin, prepare slot 0 as Cyndaquil, mount it, settle, and bind the current actor. This gives no path, stream, motion, or control-return credit.

limits: Covers one clear 20-tile east route, one field-stream boundary, and one west recovery on Route29.
Does not prove diagonal custom streaming, field transitions, blocked paths, or every map boundary.

events.value: Prepare and bind mounted Cyndaquil at Route29 (584,403)
Hold RIGHT until x=604, release through the policy skid, then tap LEFT and drain one recovery tile
Observe 22 to 24 ordered public path advances, commits, and control returns

stop.condition: The route, bounded stop skid, and one-tile recovery complete at x=604 through x=606 with stock stream state and mounted control

invariants: The same live mounted Cyndaquil reaches the 20-tile target, drains one or two skid tiles and at most one queued east Walk, and completes one west recovery Walk
Every PATH_ADVANCED event occurs before its LOGICAL_COMMIT event
Each Walk exposes ordered public path states 1 then 2; the route and recovery end in idle state 0
No active actors share a nonzero target reservation
Every active actor handle uses the current field context and has an attached presentation
Mounted control returns idle at x=604 through x=606
